ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is an anatomical/external-form schematic diagram of a fish, with multiple letters pointing by dashed lines to different parts of the fish. The letter C is located on the far right side of the image, and the dashed line points to the large tail fin at the fish’s tail. Reasoning: The question asks which part of the fish the letter C refers to. The tail fin at the fish’s tail is called the caudal fin in fish anatomical terminology, therefore C refers to the caudal part.
